steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Now then, where to start an investigation...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ooh, over there—

steps.name: Encumbered Samurai
steps.text: Watch out, mind your head.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So what are you all up to?

steps.name: Encumbered Samurai
steps.text: Ah, Madam Iju Hunter.

steps.name: Encumbered Samurai
steps.text: We're moving this Escorchgot corpse to the palace.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I thought you used their shells to make some kinda charcoal. Why drag it to the palace?

steps.name: Encumbered Samurai
steps.text: Because its flesh can also be eaten once Her Majesty purifies it.

steps.name: Encumbered Samurai
steps.text: These past ten years have seen our hunting grounds shrink due to the Lord of Thunder. We can't afford to waste even a single morsel.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Purify? Can Pop—Her Majesty really do that sort of thing?

steps.name: Encumbered Samurai
steps.text: Of course she can. That is precisely why she is our lord.

steps.name: Encumbered Samurai
steps.text: There are some things only Her Majesty can do.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I see, so she purifies them at the palace...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Can I watch?

steps.name: Encumbered Samurai
steps.text: A thousand pardons, but the ceremony is performed on sacred ground. Not even Iju Hunters are allowed in so easily.

steps.name: Encumbered Samurai
steps.text: If you wish to witness it, please ask the shogun or Her Majesty herself for permission.

steps.name: Encumbered Samurai
steps.text: Don't just stand there, keep hauling! Her Majesty is waiting for us!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hmm, so Hofukaru's getting ready for the purification, while the shogun's, err... I don't quite know where he is. So basically they gave me the cold shoulder.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Heh, but the more you tell me no, the more I want to do it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Gotta investigate what's going on here, after all!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Assuming I'm being monitored, does that mean everything I saw just now was an act?)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (I don't really see any gaps in their defenses...)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Hmm, now that I think about it, this place isn't a nomadic city, is it?)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Excuse me, but can this city move?

steps.name: Houei Commoner A
steps.text: That is an incredibly strange question you've asked me, Madam Iju Hunter.

steps.name: Houei Commoner A
steps.text: How could a city move? By my reckoning, the Gyorin has been towering over my head for decades now.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If your cities don't move, how do you deal with Catastrophes?

steps.name: Houei Commoner A
steps.text: 'Catastrophes'? And what might those be?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: A Catastrophe is, well, a disaster like an Iju?

steps.name: Houei Commoner A
steps.text: Never heard of one before.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Do your people not suffer from Oripathy?

steps.name: Houei Commoner A
steps.text: 'Oripathy'?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's a disease that makes stones grow out of your skin—
Boom!
A tremendous blast suddenly rips through the air from a distant building, as all sorts of strange bamboo implements are flung sky-high.
Something cannon-shaped falls to the ground, sending sparks flying as it skids to a stop by their feet.
Then comes a roof, floating gently down.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Workshop Apprentice
steps.text: Hah, hah.... S-Someone, help, quickly! Master Suponosuke's workshop exploded!

steps.name: Houei Commoner A
steps.text: *sigh*... This sort of thing is a daily occurrence for him. He'll be fine on his own, won't he?

steps.name: Workshop Apprentice
steps.text: Today's different! He went to the warehouse and got some Escorchgot shells. Said he wanted to make something big.

steps.name: Workshop Apprentice
steps.text: R-right now, he... he's got a bunch of rocks stuck in him! He needs help!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Wait, an Escorchgot's shell would be the crystals on the slug's back, right? If those Originium crystals exploded—)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (I'm such an idiot! I should've realized when I saw those corpses earlier!)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (If it was an Originium explosion...)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (He'll die!)

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Ow ow ow...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Spot!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: It's Suponosuke! Ow...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're alright!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: I added some pressure to the cannon's chamber. Didn't think this stuff would be so finicky.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: I assumed ammo made from Escarcoal would be rock-solid, but it shattered as soon as I fired it. Went all over the place...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Let me see!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Huh? There's nothing to see, just a scratch. I'm used to this—Hey, ow! Ease up a little!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Just a scratch?! This is an Originium explo...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: sion...?
Orchid examines the shards of crystal on the floor.
Her years of experience had taught her to recognize an Originium crystal with a single glance.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: These crystals... aren't Originium?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: What's Originium?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The slugs are covered with Originium crystals on their backs. If you get cut by one, it'll aggravate your Oripathy—

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Okay, but what's Oripathy?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Hey, what're you doing?!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Don't come any closer, or I'll scream—

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: HELP—
Orchid tears open Suponosuke's shirt.
She knows for a fact that there should be two prominent crystals by Spot's belly button.
But the only thing on Suponosuke's belly is a very healthy-looking coat of fur.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Do you have any stones growing out of your body?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So you really... aren't Spot?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: I already told you, it's Suponosuke! SU-PO-NO-SU-KE!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's impossible...

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: But when you ask me that so seriously, it almost makes me doubt my own name...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hmm, there's still one other possibility.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You took a bag of crystals from the Escorchgot's back, right?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: What about it?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Where's that warehouse you got them from?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: The tall building next to the palace.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Yes, there's still another explanation.)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (That the Escorchgot, or rather, the Originium slug corpses aren't being gathered to make 'Escarcoal', but instead...)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Someone here is gathering them to hide the fact that Originium exists.)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (I need to find those corpses.)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Thanks, you rest up now.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Hey, hey!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: What a strange woman.
Catapult skillfully leaps over several beams, all without making a sound.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whoa, that was close. Good thing the people here aren't too vigilant.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: This is where Popukar—no, Hofukaru is holding the ceremony.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Let's see what she's up to...
The Escorchgot corpses lie quietly on the ground after being hauled in by the samurai.
The afternoon sun shines into the room, highlighting the black miasma wafting off of them.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So what is this curse, exactly?
In the middle of the empty room sits Lady Hofukaru, mouthing something to the corpses.
Behind her are two orderly rows of kneeling maids, their faces shrouded.
Everything is silent.
A hallowed space, yet a strange one.
'Ring—'
'This body as a cage—'
Upon the first chime of the bell, the maids begin to sing in unison, as Hofukaru dances to their tune.
Then, something Catapult could never have imagined happens.
The black vapor is drawn away from the slugs by some unseen force.
The best analogy she can come up with is that it is like it's being sucked up by a vacuum cleaner.
And that vacuum cleaner is without a doubt the dancing Hofukaru.
As the dance progresses, her body is slowly covered in a layer of faint light. The black vapor gathers onto her, before ultimately being absorbed.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Wait... She looks like she's in pain... That black stuff is heading straight for her!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Right, Popukar's got that special eye... Is that why they're making her do this?)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (That's awful! This isn't purification, this is torture! I knew something was off! I can't believe they're using her like this!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (I can't watch this. I gotta stop her!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You people sure got guts!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Madam Catapult?!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Withdraw, quickly! The ritual is not yet complete, and the curse will harm thee!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Withdraw? Yeah right.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Don't get taken in by their lies! There's something wrong with this ceremony! They're using it to torture you! I'll get you out of here!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Torture? No—
Continue the ritual, Your Meowjesty.
Leave this miscreant to me.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...Very well. I shall complete it posthaste.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: A talking cloudbeast...?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I am no 'cloudbeast', I am Meowsamune! I mean, Masamune!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I heard the new generation of Iju Hunters had arrived, so I decided to have a look.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: But I never thought you'd be pawsitively insane.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Insane? You're the ones who're insane!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: You don't understand a thing about what's going on here... so allow me to educate mew!
